patch.summary: VektorOS implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement VektorOS by mapping current project-management workflows to VektorOS objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (priority systems) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on systems of record

blocks.heading: VektorOS day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat VektorOS setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for task boards, timeline / Gantt, automations and workflows before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Service SMBs coordinating client delivery before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate priority integrations before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities

Do not expand seats until task boards is green

blocks.title: VektorOS plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: 14-day trial · Contact sales · Unlocks: task boards, timeline / Gantt, automations and workflows · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.title: Validate project-management fit before a deep VektorOS rollout
blocks.body: If VektorOS fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.
